title: Vegetarian French Sausage Tagine
description: A twist on the traditional Moroccan tagine, this vegetarian version is packed with the flavors of French sausages and hearty vegetables.

ingredients.name: French sausages
ingredients.notes: look for vegetarian sausages made from tofu or tempeh

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the French sausages and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin and coriander and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, covered, until the vegetables are tender and the sausages are cooked through, about 20 minutes.
Season the tagine with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
